name: pulse-theory-landing
description: Demo landing page for Pulse Theory, a fictional online fitness coaching brand. Bootstrap 5 + Sass + vanilla JS.
author: Renzzo G. (https://renzzogg.com)

scripts.build: npm run build:static && npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css: sass --load-path=node_modules --style=compressed --no-source-map --quiet-deps --silence-deprecation=import src/scss/main.scss dist/css/main.css && postcss dist/css/main.css --replace --no-map --use autoprefixer
